name: local-documents
description: Fast access to local PDF, XLSX and DOCX files: extract text, render pages, read and search documents and spreadsheets, and surgically edit Excel workbooks.
long_description:
Local Documents gives Claude access to PDF, Excel (.xlsx/.xlsm) and Word (.docx) files inside folders you choose.

- **PDF**: page count and metadata, text extraction from the existing text layer, and page rendering to images for scanned or visual pages.
- **XLSX**: sheet overview, reading cell ranges (with optional formulas), and searching across sheets.
- **XLSX editing** (`xlsx_edit`): one transactional batch of cell values, formulas, clears and new sheets for .xlsx and .xlsm. Workbooks are edited surgically as OOXML packages: only the affected XML elements change and every unrelated part — charts, pivot tables, macros, add-ins, customXml, SharePoint metadata, custom styles and properties — is copied byte-for-byte. Edits are saved to a **new workbook** by default; the original is only replaced when explicitly requested with overwrite=true.
- **DOCX**: document properties and outline, text as Markdown with headings, lists, tables, footnotes and comments in reading order, table extraction, and search.

Everything runs inside the extension using pure JavaScript and WebAssembly (pdf.js, PDFium, ExcelJS, officeparser). No Python, Microsoft Office, LibreOffice or other external programs are needed, and the same package works on macOS and Windows. PDF and Word files are never modified; spreadsheets are only written by the editing tools, and never outside the allowed folders. Paths outside the allowed folders — including via `..` or symbolic links — are rejected, for both reading and writing.

tools.name: pdf_info
tools.description: Get page count, metadata, page sizes, and whether a PDF has a text layer.

tools.name: pdf_read_text
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF's existing text layer, optionally for selected pages.

tools.name: pdf_render_page
tools.description: Render a PDF page to an image (for scanned or visual pages).

tools.name: xlsx_info
tools.description: List worksheets, used ranges, defined names, and workbook properties.

tools.name: xlsx_read_range
tools.description: Read cell values from a worksheet range.

tools.name: xlsx_search
tools.description: Find cells containing text across sheets.

tools.name: xlsx_edit
tools.description: Transactionally set cell values/formulas, clear cells and add sheets in an .xlsx/.xlsm, preserving all unrelated content byte-for-byte.

tools.name: docx_info
tools.description: Get a Word document's properties, heading outline, tables and counts.

tools.name: docx_read_text
tools.description: Read a Word document as Markdown in reading order (headings, lists, tables, notes).

tools.name: docx_read_tables
tools.description: Extract a Word document's tables, including merged cells.

tools.name: docx_search
tools.description: Find text in a Word document with its location.

allowed_directories.title: Allowed folders
allowed_directories.description: Folders Claude may read PDF, XLSX and DOCX files from (including subfolders). Edited workbooks are also saved only inside these folders.
